note: Who may approve docs/product/domain-model.md, and the GitHub login whose review is that approval (CO-02; reconciliation-001, D1; docs/adr/0063). pnpm db:domain-model --check --require-approval refuses a name on the approval line that is not exactly an entry's name here (apart from spaces at either end, in the same case), and an empty list refuses every approval. The approval-of-record job, reading this list from the base branch, requires of a pull request that changes the approval line or this list an APPROVED review of its latest commit from the login of the person the line names (any login here when the line names no one), never from the pull request's author. This list changes only under the founder's approval of record.
